title: Add GLM 5.3 Flash results
description: This is the entire prompt, hillclimbed by Opus 5.5: > Predict the user's next code edit. Rewrite the given region with that edit applied, reproducing every other line of the region exactly, and output only the region, wrapped in a four-backtick (````) code fence. The region may start or end mid-statement; keep those partial lines as they are. Latency is the main issue. Baseten doesn't actually allow for disabling reasoning with GLM 5.3 Flash (I'm not sure that the base model does either), so the model tends to reason for a couple sentences before responding.
